component.name: Tomescope
component.summary: Ebook and comic reader with notes and flashcards

description.p: Tomescope reads EPUB, PDF, CBZ, FB2, Markdown, HTML and plain text, and keeps what you make of them alongside the books.

ul.li: Highlights and margin notes that survive a reflow
Flashcards with spaced repetition, made from what you highlighted
Library shelves, reading stats and OPDS import
